STRICT FILE BOUNDARIES — you may ONLY create/edit files under:
- /opt/nxeon/app/admin/** (EXCEPT app/admin/layout.tsx — do not touch)
- /opt/nxeon/components/admin/** (new client components go here)
Do NOT touch: lib/, worker/, prisma/, app/dashboard, app/api, app/globals.css, components/ui/, components/portal/, config files. Do NOT run npm run build, npm install, git, or systemctl — the orchestrator handles builds/deploys.

- CSS classes (app/globals.css): .card .card-hover .glass .btn-primary .btn-secondary .btn-danger .btn-ghost .input .label .page-title .section-label .grad-text .table-shell .kbd; colors navy-950..600, brand-300..600, accent-blue; dark glass premium theme, rounded-2xl.
- components/ui/primitives.tsx: PageHeader, StatCard(label,value,delta,deltaGood,spark,sparkColor,icon,href), StatusDot, Badge(tone: brand|green|red|amber|slate), EmptyState, ComingSoon(feature,note), fmtBytes, fmtMoney, timeAgo
- components/ui/charts.tsx: Sparkline(data,id,stroke), AreaChart({series:[{name,data,color}],id,yLabel,xLabels,maxY,height}), Donut({segments:[{value,color}],centerLabel,centerSub}), MeterBar(value,max,color)
- components/StatusBadge.tsx, components/AutoRefresh.tsx (5s router.refresh), components/AdminControls.tsx (SuspendServerButton, SuspendUserButton, CreditForm, GrantForm), components/SubscriptionControls.tsx (ExtendForm, FreeToggle), components/PlanForm.tsx (PlanForm)
- Server actions "@/lib/actions": adminGrantFreeVps(prev,fd: userId,planId,osTemplateId,hostname), adminSuspendServer(id,suspend), adminSetUserSuspended(id,suspended), adminCreditUser(prev,fd: userId,amount), adminSavePlan(prev,fd), adminExtendServer(prev,fd: serverId,days), adminSetServerFree(id,isFree), serverAction(serverId, start|stop|reboot|reinstall|delete)
- "@/lib/actions-account": impersonateUser(userId) — redirects to /dashboard as that user; renders customer portal with an exit banner (already handled globally).
- "@/lib/actions-support": replyTicket(prev, fd: ticketId, body), setTicketStatus(id,"OPEN"|"CLOSED"), setTicketPriority(id, "LOW"|"NORMAL"|"HIGH"|"URGENT")
- "@/lib/auth": requireAdmin() — call at top of every page's server component.
- "@/lib/db": db (Prisma). Models: User(id,email,name,role[CUSTOMER|ADMIN],balanceCents,suspended,createdAt,servers,transactions,tickets,domains), Plan(slug,name,cpuCores,ramMB,diskGB,bandwidthTB,priceCents,active,sortOrder,servers), OsTemplate(slug,name,vmid,active), Server(id,hostname,vmid,status[PENDING|PROVISIONING|RUNNING|STOPPED|SUSPENDED|REINSTALLING|DELETING|ERROR],ipAddress,sshPort,isFree,autoRenew,suspendedNote,expiresAt,createdAt,user,plan,osTemplate,jobs,portForwards,projectId), Job(id,type[PROVISION|START|STOP|REBOOT|REINSTALL|DELETE|SUSPEND|UNSUSPEND|RESIZE|SNAPSHOT_*|BACKUP_CREATE|SYNC_FORWARDS],status[QUEUED|RUNNING|DONE|FAILED],payload,error,attempts,serverId,server,createdAt,updatedAt), WalletTransaction(userId,user,amountCents,description,createdAt), AuditLog(userId,user,action,detail,createdAt), Ticket(subject,status[OPEN|ANSWERED|CUSTOMER_REPLY|CLOSED],priority[LOW|NORMAL|HIGH|URGENT],user,messages,createdAt,updatedAt), TicketMessage(body,isStaff,author,createdAt), Domain(name,status,priceCents,autoRenew,expiresAt,user), Notification, Project, SshKey
- "@/lib/proxmox": nodeStatus() → {cpu,cpuinfo:{model,cpus},memory:{used,total},rootfs:{used,total},uptime,loadavg,kversion}, listVms() → [{vmid,name,status,cpu,cpus,mem,maxmem,disk,maxdisk,netin,netout,uptime,template}], vmStatus(vmid), storageStatus("vmdata"|"backup"|"local") → {used,total,avail}, listBackups(), listSnapshots(vmid). ALWAYS wrap pve calls in try/catch with graceful fallback UI.
- GET /api/metrics?tf=hour|day|week|month (admin: node metrics) → {data:[{time,cpu,maxcpu,memused,memtotal,netin,netout,...}]} — rrd fields for nodes are: cpu (fraction), maxcpu, memused, memtotal, netin, netout, iowait, loadavg, swapused, rootused. Filter nulls.
- Env: PROXMOX_NODE (node name), PUBLIC_IP.

CONVENTIONS: server components default with `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`; client components only for interactivity (useActionState / useTransition); params/searchParams are Promises in Next 15. NO fake/mock data — every figure from Prisma or Proxmox. Where a capability physically doesn't exist yet on this single-node platform (multi-datacenter, load balancers, BGP, abuse-detection ML, live chat) use the ComingSoon component with an honest note — sparingly, grouped, never a whole fake dashboard.

BUILD THESE PAGES (replace existing files where they exist):

1. app/admin/page.tsx — OPS OVERVIEW, the command center: top StatCard row (MRR = sum of active non-free servers' plan.priceCents; Active customers = users with ≥1 server; Total servers + running count as delta; Open tickets; Failed jobs 24h, deltaGood=false when >0; Wallet liabilities = sum of all user balances). Second row: hypervisor health card (nodeStatus: CPU MeterBar, memory MeterBar, uptime, load, kernel) + storage card (storageStatus for vmdata + backup: Donut or MeterBars with fmtBytes) + revenue-last-14-days AreaChart (group WalletTransactions with amountCents<0 by day, sum abs, xLabels dates). AutoRefresh if any active jobs.

2. app/admin/analytics.page → app/admin/analytics/page.tsx — business analytics from REAL data: revenue by month (last 6 months bar-ish AreaChart from WalletTransactions<0), customer signups by week (User.createdAt), plan distribution Donut (servers per plan, colored), ARPU (revenue last 30d / active customers), churn proxy card (servers deleted last 30d via AuditLog action server.delete count), top customers by monthly spend table. Label each metric honestly (e.g. "since launch" when history is short).

3. app/admin/users/page.tsx — client roster: search input (server-side ?q= filter on email/name via searchParams), table (name/email, role, suspended badge, servers count, balance, monthly spend, joined, actions: view →, Impersonate button (client, impersonateUser with confirm), SuspendUserButton). 4. app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx — customer 360 (rebuild existing): profile header with Impersonate + Suspend + CreditForm; stat cards (balance, monthly spend, servers, tickets); tabs or stacked sections: servers table (status, plan, IP, expires, quick suspend), transactions, tickets (link to /admin/support/[id]), domains, audit trail, SSH keys count, notifications sent. Link to owner.

7. app/admin/provisioning/page.tsx — ops queue: stat row (queued, running, failed 24h, avg attempts on failed); active jobs table (AutoRefresh); failed jobs table with full error text expandable (details/summary), attempts; note that failed jobs retry automatically up to 3 attempts.

8. app/admin/monitoring/page.tsx + components/admin/NodeMetrics.tsx — client metrics panel fetching /api/metrics?tf= with pills (1h/24h/7d/30d, refresh 30s): AreaCharts for node CPU % (cpu*100, maxY 100), memory used GB (memused/1e9, maxY memtotal/1e9), network in/out KB/s. Below (server-rendered): per-VM live table from listVms() (exclude templates): vmid, name, status dot, cpu%, mem/maxmem MeterBar, disk, uptime — join with Server rows to link hostname → admin server page; orphan VMs (no Server row, vmid<9000) flagged with amber Badge "unmanaged".

9. app/admin/infrastructure/page.tsx — the real hardware story: node card (model, cores, kernel, uptime, load), storage pools (vmdata NVMe mirror, backup 4TB HDD, local — storageStatus each: MeterBar + fmtBytes + purpose note), capacity planning card (sum of plan.ramMB of non-suspended servers vs 64GB host RAM => overcommit ratio; same for disk vs vmdata total; warn amber >80%, red >100%), network card (public IP, NAT subnet 10.20.0.0/24, allocated IPs count /150, SSH port range 20000-29999 usage count), templates table (OsTemplate rows with vmid + active toggle note to manage in DB). Section for "Additional nodes" → ComingSoon (multi-node scheduling on roadmap).

10. app/admin/subscriptions/page.tsx — keep existing functionality but restyle to new system: stats row (StatCards), overdue highlighted, ExtendForm + FreeToggle, autoRenew column, renewal engine explainer footnote.

12. app/admin/support/page.tsx — support desk: queue stats (open, awaiting-staff = OPEN+CUSTOMER_REPLY, answered, closed 7d), priority-sorted ticket table (URGENT first): subject, customer, priority Badge (URGENT red/HIGH amber/NORMAL brand/LOW slate), status StatusDot, updated timeAgo. app/admin/support/[id]/page.tsx — thread view (staff bubbles right/brand, customer left/glass), reply form (replyTicket — replies as staff), priority select (client, setTicketPriority), close/reopen, customer context sidebar card (email link to /admin/users/[id], balance, server count, joined).

Webhooks/auto-scaling → ComingSoon.

15. app/admin/settings/page.tsx — platform settings: integration status cards (Stripe, Namecheap, GitHub remote — for GitHub read whether .git remote exists is not accessible; instead instruct: run scripts/setup-github.sh), OS templates table (from OsTemplate), plan quick-links, env-based config display (PUBLIC_IP, PROXMOX_NODE, APP_URL — read from process.env, never print secrets, only SET/NOT SET status), danger notes. 1	# Nxeon — VPS hosting platform
2	
3	Hostinger-style VPS hosting platform running on this Proxmox VE 9 dedicated server (OVH KS-GAME, i7-7700K, 64GB RAM, 2×450GB NVMe ZFS mirror + 4TB HDD backup pool).
4	
5	## Architecture
6	
7	- **Web panel**: Next.js 15 (App Router, server actions) + Tailwind v4, served by `nxeon-web.service` on port 3000, behind nginx on port 80. Public IP: 51.79.162.96.
8	- **Worker**: `worker/index.ts` run by `nxeon-worker.service` (as root — it manages iptables). Polls the `Job` table every 3s and executes provisioning/lifecycle jobs against the Proxmox API.
9	- **DB**: PostgreSQL 17, database `nxeon`, Prisma ORM ([prisma/schema.prisma](prisma/schema.prisma)). Use `npm run db:push` after schema changes.
10	- **Proxmox**: API token auth (`nxeon@pve!platform`, creds in `.env`). Templates: VMID 9000 (Ubuntu 24.04), 9001 (Debian 13), cloud-init based, cloned onto ZFS storage `vmdata`.
11	- **Networking**: VMs attach to NAT bridge `vmbr1` (10.20.0.0/24, gateway .1). IPs allocated from 10.20.0.100–250 ([lib/ipam.ts](lib/ipam.ts)). SSH exposed via DNAT port forwards 20000–29999 in iptables chain `NXEON_FWD`, rebuilt from DB by [worker/network.ts](worker/network.ts) — never edit that chain by hand.
12	- **Cloud-init**: vendor snippet at `/tank/backup/snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml` (installs qemu-guest-agent, enables root password SSH).
13	
14	## Conventions
15	
16	- All state changes to VMs go through `Job` rows — the web app never calls Proxmox mutation endpoints directly (read-only status calls are OK).
17	- One in-flight job per server (enforced in `serverAction`).
18	- Admin-only actions live in [lib/actions.ts](lib/actions.ts) and must call `requireAdmin()`.
19	- Free VPSes: `Server.isFree = true`, no billing, `expiresAt = null`.
20	- Wallet amounts are integer cents.
21	
22	## Commands
23	
24	- Build: `npm run build` (must pass before restarting services)
25	- Deploy after changes: `npm run build && systemctl restart nxeon-web nxeon-worker`
26	- Worker logs: `journalctl -u nxeon-worker -f`
27	- E2E test: `npx tsx scripts/e2e-test.ts` (orders a real VM; delete it afterwards via a DELETE job)
28	- Admin credentials: `/root/nxeon-credentials.txt`
29	
30	## Safety rules
31	
32	- NEVER touch VMIDs 9000–9999 (templates) except to add new templates.
33	- Never `qm destroy` a VM that has a `Server` row — always go through a DELETE job.
34	- Do not commit `.env`. Do not print the Proxmox token into logs or docs.
35	- Always `git commit` working states; never leave the tree broken — services restart from this directory.

# Nxeon roadmap

Continuous-improvement backlog, highest priority first. Agents: pick the top unchecked item you can complete end-to-end in one session, implement it, test it (build + E2E where relevant), commit, check it off with a dated note, then stop. Add newly discovered work as new items rather than expanding scope mid-task.

## Summary

Built the complete Nxeon admin operations portal — 17 page files and 4 new client components, all strict-TypeScript clean (`npx tsc --noEmit` passes; no build/install/git run per the boundary rules).

### Files created
**Components** (`/opt/nxeon/components/admin/`):
- `NodeMetrics.tsx` — client metrics panel: 1h/24h/7d/30d pills, 30s auto-refetch of `/api/metrics`, CPU % / memory GB / net KB/s AreaCharts, null-filtered RRD rows, skeleton + honest empty state
- `ImpersonateButton.tsx` — confirm-guarded `impersonateUser`
- `ServerAdminActions.tsx` — `PowerActions` (start/stop/reboot, useTransition + confirm, state-aware disabling) and `DangerDelete` (arm → type-hostname → confirm dialog → DELETE job)
- `TicketControls.tsx` — `ReplyForm` (useActionState, resets on success), `PrioritySelect`, `TicketStatusButton`

**Pages** (`/opt/nxeon/app/admin/`): `page.tsx` (ops overview), `analytics/page.tsx`, `users/page.tsx`, `users/[id]/page.tsx`, `servers/page.tsx`, `servers/[id]/page.tsx` (new), `provisioning/page.tsx` (new), `monitoring/page.tsx` (new), `infrastructure/page.tsx` (new), `subscriptions/page.tsx` (restyled), `billing/page.tsx` (new), `support/page.tsx` + `support/[id]/page.tsx` (new), `domains/page.tsx` (new), `automation/page.tsx` (new), `settings/page.tsx` (new), `grant/page.tsx` (restyled).

### Key implementation notes
- Every figure is real: MRR/ARPU/liabilities/revenue series from Prisma aggregates; hypervisor/storage/VM stats from `nodeStatus`/`storageStatus`/`listVms`/`vmStatus`, each wrapped in try/catch with explicit "Proxmox unreachable" fallback UI
- Verified worker semantics before writing copy: retries = `MAX_ATTEMPTS 3` in `worker/index.ts`; billing audit actions are `billing.renewed` / `billing.suspended_unpaid`; domain revenue matched on tx descriptions `Domain registration:`/`Domain renewal:` from `lib/actions-domains.ts`
- Automation page parses `- [x]` lines from `/opt/nxeon/ROADMAP.md` via `readFileSync` in try/catch (last 5, newest first)
- Monitoring flags VMs with no Server row and vmid < 9000 as amber "unmanaged"; capacity planning colors amber >80% / red >100% with an overcommit warning banner
- `requireAdmin()` at the top of every page; `params`/`searchParams` awaited as Promises; `force-dynamic` everywhere; all tables `.table-shell` inside `.card p-0 overflow-x-auto`

### Deviations (deliberate)
- **CreditForm moved off the roster** into the customer 360 header (per the "your call" allowance); the roster notes this and the quick-action card says "from a client profile"
- Roadmap parsing takes all `- [x]` lines, not only the `## Done` section — dated completed items also live under P2/P3, so this is more truthful
- Legacy `/admin/jobs`, `/admin/audit`, `/admin/plans` left untouched (audit/plans are still in the nav and referenced by links; jobs is orphaned but out of scope)

Nothing is incomplete; the orchestrator can run the build/deploy.
